items.question: Are loop bounds, comparisons and off-by-one cases right for empty, single and full inputs?
Is every possibly undefined or null value checked before use, without non-null assertions that hide a real gap?
Are promises awaited or returned, and are rejected promises handled?
Do exported function signatures, types and error shapes match what callers and the spec expect?
Is input from outside the process (tool arguments, files, environment, stdin) validated before use?
Are child processes started with argument arrays and never through a shell string?
Are numbers safe from division by zero, NaN and Infinity, and are units (ms, LOC) consistent?
Is data written in a stable order and format so the output is deterministic?
Do names and comments describe what the code actually does?
